what: Layered sections on a one-screen plate flip horizontally one at a time by one wheel (direction only) · one horizontal swipe (40px) · the next button · the number dots. Only the incoming and outgoing sections slide 100% over 1s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), and no further input is accepted for 1s after a flip. It loops endlessly from the end to the start and exports the flip count as --fx-count so the background behind (panorama) can drift by that much. is-current goes on the current slot of the number dots and title group (sync).

options.threshold: Horizontal push distance (px) counted as a flip, default 40
options.--fx-dur / --fx-ease: Slide duration · curve (via style), default 1s · cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)
options.--fx-span: Push-out distance (via style), default 100% (on the original phone 100lvh)
options.--fx-count / --fx-total: Value exported by the part — background bleed: background-position: calc(200% / var(--fx-total) * var(--fx-count)) center
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Number dots (optional) — click to jump to that section (no lock between dots)
options.[data-fx-part=sync]: Group whose children receive is-current in section order (optional) — text such as titles and names layered outside the sections
options.fx:slide / fx:slide-end: When passing ({ index, count, dir })·fires from the panel when the lock is released — used to turn the cursor into a dot shape

note: The wheel is blocked from page scroll over the panel (for a hero where the panel fills one screen). Touch is not blocked — swiping vertically scrolls the page

from.where: index.js .hs (horizontal person swipe) — original scrollSlide: _goNext/_goPrev count±1 · Ao(1000) lock · swipeThreshold 40 · axis lock 10px · translate-x-[100vw] transition-transform duration-1000 (curve cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)) · --city background-position 1.2s ease
